## [1.5.0-dev.1](https://github.com/Plyrs1/morphe-patches/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0-dev.1) (2026-10-01)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **shared:** register Android Auto compatibility target ([26b8fe1](https://github.com/Plyrs1/morphe-patches/commit/26b8fe1bed8e729cf821f910155be1dab36d2b89))

### ✨ New Features

* **com_google_android_projection_gearhead:** add allow sideloaded apps patch ([15558b4](https://github.com/Plyrs1/morphe-patches/commit/15558b4f74ebd362f6dabff436d0e9936e4d0902))

patches.name: Allow System UI
patches.description: Allows the status bar and navigation bar to remain visible during the exam.

patches.name: Background Persistence (WakeLock + Foreground Service)
patches.description: Keeps the exam process alive in the background using a WakeLock-backed foreground Service. Prevents OS from killing the exam when backgrounded or screen turns off. Service restarts automatically via START_STICKY if killed.

patches.name: Bypass App Blacklist Scan
patches.description: Skips the pre-exam scan that blocks exam start if blacklisted apps (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, screen recorders, floating apps) are installed, and launches the exam directly without overlay/DND/ringer prompts.

patches.name: Bypass DND Detection
patches.description: Allows the exam to run with Do Not Disturb mode enabled.

patches.name: Bypass Multi-Window Detection
patches.description: Disables split-screen detection so the exam continues normally in split-screen mode.

patches.name: Bypass PiP Detection
patches.description: Allows the exam to continue when entered into Picture-in-Picture mode.

patches.name: Bypass Silent Mode Detection
patches.description: Allows the exam to run with the device on silent or vibrate.

patches.name: Bypass Startup Security Checks
patches.description: Skips environment, VM, emulator, hook, and cloner detection in SplashActivity. Allows the app to run on emulators, rooted devices, and virtual environments.

patches.name: Disable Clipboard Guard
patches.description: Prevents the app from wiping the clipboard on exam start and when copying text.

patches.name: Disable Focus Loss Alarm
patches.description: Prevents the delayed alarm triggered when the exam window loses focus.

patches.name: Disable onPause Alarm
patches.description: Prevents the alarm from triggering when the exam activity is paused or backgrounded.

patches.name: Disable Overlay Guard
patches.description: Stops the OverlayGuard system window and foreground-recovery loop on focus loss.

patches.name: Disable Touch Obscurity Detection
patches.description: Removes the overlay-touch detection that fires an alarm when another window partially covers the exam.

patches.name: Disable Violation Alarm
patches.description: Suppresses the max-volume alarm tone and vibration triggered on any exam security violation.

patches.name: Manifest: Background Persistence Permissions
patches.description: Adds WAKE_LOCK, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE permissions, registers ExamKeepAliveService, and removes lockTaskMode/excludeFromRecents from ExamActivity.

patches.name: Remove Auto-Pin App
patches.description: Disables automatic screen pinning / lock task mode so the app is not pinned to the screen.

patches.name: Remove Screenshot Protection
patches.description: Removes FLAG_SECURE so screenshots and screen recording work normally during the exam.

patches.name: Suppress WebView Exam Events
patches.description: Injects a JavaScript monkeypatch into the exam WebView on every page load that freezes the Page Visibility API (document.hidden, document.visibilityState, document.hasFocus) and silently drops blur/visibilitychange/focusout event listeners. This prevents the web-side exam platform from detecting when the browser loses focus or is backgrounded.

patches.name: Disable Startup Permissions
patches.description: Suppresses indiscriminate startup requests for camera and storage permissions, and configures manifest for direct system camera capture.

patches.name: Hide Gift Button
patches.description: Hides the gift / donation button in the top action bar of the main menu.

patches.name: Remove All Ads
patches.description: Disables all AdMob preloading, bypasses interstitial ads, and auto-removes the watermark on receipt screens without user interaction.

patches.name: Allow sideloaded apps
patches.description: Bypasses Play Store installation checks, allowing sideloaded third-party apps to appear and run on the Android Auto car head unit.

patches.name: Disable Google Services
patches.description: Disables Firebase Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring, Sessions, Installations, Remote Config network fetch, DataTransport telemetry pipeline, FCM push notifications, AdMob stub, and bypasses the privacy preferences dialog. Retains local Remote Config defaults for feature flags and preserves all Habitica API traffic.

patches.name: Instant Armoire Reward
patches.description: Shows the Armoire ad button and instantly grants the reward without loading an ad. The existing per-session single-use guard is preserved.

patches.name: Self-Hosted Server Support
patches.description: Always shows the custom server settings button on the login screen, enabling connection to self-hosted Habitica backends without a secret gesture.

patches.name: Bypass Review Dialog
patches.description: Bypasses the in-app review confirmation dialog when pressing Back on the Home screen, allowing immediate exit.

patches.name: Hide Premium Button
patches.description: Hides the Premium upgrade button from both the top action bar on the Home screen and the Settings menu.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes all banner and interstitial ads by unlocking ad-free premium status and disabling AdMob loaders.

patches.name: Disable Licensing
patches.description: Bypasses PairIP license verification to prevent 'Something went wrong' errors on emulators and devices without Google Play.

patches.name: First Launch Credit
patches.description: Shows a one-time 'Patched with ❤️ by Plyrs' notification on first launch.

patches.name: Lifetime Premium
patches.description: Unlocks lifetime premium: removes watermark forever, disables ads, unlocks all templates.
